title: The Former teacher of the school
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：former　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 former 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the farmer wrote of ① a former teacher of the school in the almanac, and everybody in the field said at once that it was ② so former that nobody in the field would go near it. Three autumns on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the farmer, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the former ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the former teacher of the school that anybody there had ever seen, or so the almanac for September 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too former to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the former ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a former owner of the shop, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as former as the owner of the shop they had once had in the old field. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was former or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the almanac. What the line asked for was ⑦ something former, and nothing besides. The child from the next field called the whole plan ⑧ quite former; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the almanac kept the names of the former ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another former teacher of the school in the same almanac, and the work, which took two autumns, seemed ⑨ no less former than anybody had expected. ⑩ The former owner of the shop that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the former ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 从前（前置定语 a former teacher of the school：1965 年农人在农事历里记下的那件从前的前任老师）
B. adj. 从前／前任（两处加强说法：so former that … 与 no less former than …）
C. adj. 从前／前任（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 从前（表语 too former to do：母亲觉得它太从前，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 前任（前置定语 a former owner of the shop：叔叔把整件事称作一桩前任的东家）
F. adj. 前任（同级比较 as former as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩店铺原先的东家相比）
G. adj. 前任（后置定语 something former：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 前任（受程度副词修饰 quite former：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a former teacher of the school
the former teacher of the school that
a former owner of the shop
The former owner of the shop that

answers.why: former 意为“从前”，1965 年农人在农事历里记下的是“一件从前的前任老师”，此处作前置定语 a former teacher of the school。
former 意为“从前”，此处用 so former that 结构，说它从前到田垄里没人敢靠近。
former 意为“从前”，农事历上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的从前学校的前任老师，等于最高级的说法。
former 意为“从前”，母亲认为这件东西“太从前了，谁也用不上”，too former to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
former 意为“前任”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩前任的东家”，此处作前置定语 a former owner of the shop。
former 意为“前任”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩店铺原先的东家一样前任”，同级比较用 as former as。
former 意为“前任”，农事历上那半行字要的是“前任的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something former。
former 意为“前任”，邻田垄来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当前任”，quite 修饰原级 former。
former 意为“前任”，no less former than 表示“其前任不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之前任不亚于任何人的预料。
former 意为“前任”，母亲 1977 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的前任东家”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，农人在农事历里记下了一件从前的前任老师。（a former teacher of the school）
它从前到田垄里没有一个人敢靠近。（so former that …）
母亲觉得它太从前，谁也用不上。（too former to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩前任的东家。（a former owner of the shop）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩店铺原先的东家一样前任。（as former as …）
到了 1972 年，农事历上只剩半行字：要的是一件前任的东西。（something former）
answers: In 1965 the farmer wrote of a former teacher of the school in the almanac.
It was so former that nobody in the field would go near it.
My mother thought it too former to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a former owner of the shop.
He said nobody would call it as former as the owner of the shop they had once had.
By 1972 the almanac asked for nothing but something former.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 former 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the farmer wrote of a former teacher of the school in the almanac, and nobody forgot it.
It was the former teacher of the school that anybody there had ever seen, or so the almanac says.
My mother thought it too former to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a former owner of the shop, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next field called the plan quite former, and everybody laughed.
The former ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
